title: FACET Assumption Record
description: Schema for a FACET assumption record (FACET specification, Appendix A.3).

id.description: Canonical assumption ID in the form assumption/<domain>/<name> (lowercase kebab-case).

statement.description: The assumption being made. Written as a positive declarative statement (e.g. 'The host operating system provides a hardware-backed secure enclave accessible via the platform keychain API.').

evidence.description: Evidence supporting this assumption. An empty array means the assumption is unvalidated.

review_by.description: ISO 8601 date by which this assumption must be reviewed. If the date has passed the assumption is stale.

criticality.description: How severely incorrect assumptions would impact the system. 'critical' means the feature cannot function safely if false.

risk_if_false.description: Description of the consequences if this assumption turns out to be incorrect.

referenced_by.description: Feature IDs (domain/capability/feature) or policy IDs (policy/<domain>/<name>) that rely on this assumption.

reference.description: URL, file path, or document title that constitutes the evidence.

date.description: ISO 8601 date when this evidence was collected or published.
